title: DirectoryListing
description: A snapshot of the directory trees under one or more root storage paths, used as reader input in conformance fixtures and dry runs. Paths are relative to their root and '/'-separated; directories end with '/'; every ancestor directory of an entry is itself listed; entries are unique and sorted.

environmentIdentifier.description: The active environment while the listing was taken. Overrides preferences.environmentIdentifier from the config when present.

dataLocationIdentifier.description: identifier of the data location this root belongs to.

rootStoragePathIdentifier.description: identifier of the rootStoragePath the entries were listed under.

entries.description: Relative paths under the root. A directory ends with '/'. No leading '/', no '.' or '..' segments.
